visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair sits in a dimly lit karaoke room, dressed in a brown fuzzy jacket. He holds a silver microphone close to his face, preparing to sing. To his right, a large digital touchscreen glows with a colorful song selection menu. The background consists of a wall with dark, swirling patterned wallpaper. (2) The man sings with a focused and emotional expression, his eyes occasionally glancing at the screen or looking forward. His mouth movements are visible as he enunciates the song's lyrics. One hand grips the microphone firmly while the other rests on his leg. The ambient lighting casts soft purple and red shadows across the scene. (3) After finishing the final lyrics, the man slowly lowers the microphone and rests it in his lap. He gazes at the touchscreen monitor, which remains active with song information. The camera remains completely still throughout this final moment, capturing his quiet composure after the performance.
